entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: 學園……我好久沒來了，\n想不到大家……\r\n都正常地跟我說話。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_01

entries.text: 只有杜若他是一邊賊賊地笑，\n一邊盯著我看……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_02

entries.text: 我向他好好道歉了。\n跟他說至今的事情……是我不好。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_03

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 你們是好朋友了！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_select_02

entries.text:
要說是好朋友唄，
總覺得又好像不太一樣……
但是……嗯，
我會努力……看看的。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_04b

entries.text: 休息了一段時間，\n我得趕上進度才行……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_05

entries.text: 謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳帶\n派帕他們來北上。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_00

entries.text: 我在老家休息的時候，\n至今為止的事始～終離不開腦袋，\r\n我覺得很難過……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_01

entries.text: 雖然也發生了\n有點奇怪的事……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_03

entries.text: 丹瑜她……
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 麻吉麻吉！？
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 沒錯！姐她很在意，\n要是提到的話會被她撂倒唄！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_05

entries.text: 沒錯沒錯！現在說起來是個笑話，\n但那時候哇咧可怕～！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_05b

entries.text: 我……雖然一直很猶豫，\n但我決定了一件事情。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_06

entries.text: 下次我會好好跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再等一下哦！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_07

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n我啊！讓他們把我……\r\n從藍莓聯盟……除名了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_00

entries.text: 為什麼！？
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 你厭倦了？
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 啊，不是因為[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\n也不是因為厭倦了之類的。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_01

entries.text: 一直以來我都想著要變強，\n想變得像[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣強……\r\n把對戰的樂趣都給忘了。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_02

entries.text: 所以，我想花一些時間\n重新檢視自己。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_03

entries.text: 不論是對夥伴還是寶可夢兒，\n我都想展現真實的自己。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_04

entries.text: 很棒的理由！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 我支持你！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 除了我以外，\n四天王以上的成員都沒有變，\r\n赤松也沒有被擠出四天王，可以放心了。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_06

entries.text: 等整理得差不多時，\n我會去爭冠軍寶座的！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_08

entries.text: 我很期待！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_05

entries.text: 我還是會贏的！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_06

entries.text: 如果可以的話，我……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_01_01

entries.text: 太好啦！\n我會用啃果蟲來交換！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_01_03

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_02_03

entries.text:
只有１隻同行寶可夢兒的話，
是不能交換的。\c
等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有２隻以上的同行寶可夢兒之後，
我們再來交換唄。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_03_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳願意和我\n交換寶可夢兒嗎……？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_04_00

entries.text: 這樣啊……\n嗯，我知道了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_cancel_00

entries.text: 太好了！那好唄，\n我們去入口唄！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_battlestart_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，抱歉哦……\n我打的是雙打對戰，\r\n希望[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳帶２隻寶可夢兒來。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_battlestart_01

entries.text: 我還沒有手機，\n所以這個給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]從烏栗那裡\n得到了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]藍莓手機殼（黑）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_reward_00

entries.text: 下次也一起開心地對戰唄！\n我們說定了哦！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
哇咧老天哦……
我竟然打贏[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了！\c
我的心臟還跳得好快……
謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……和我對戰！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
鬼牠……
厄鬼椪牠還好嗎？\c
和[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在一起的話，
牠一定會……一直都很幸福的。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
我的……宿舍房間，
現在看了覺得好丟臉。\c
裡頭還是我心急的時候的樣子。
……得趕快收拾才行。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
我覺得從嘴裡跑出方言很遜，
有好一陣子我都忍著不說。\c
噫嘿嘿……但自從我想通了以後，
就覺得根本無所謂了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]！
哇咧有勾可愛……！\c
我很細心地在培育牠，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可以放心哦！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有把我的啃果蟲
加到同行的隊伍裡嗎？\c
要是牠能幫上[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的忙就太好了。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_randomtalk_04
